name: Transparent Case Wireless Earbuds
subtitle: Bluetooth earbuds with transparent charging case
description: These true wireless earbuds feature Bluetooth connectivity, built-in microphones, touch-sensitive controls, and an in-ear fit. The transparent charging case adds a distinctive tech-inspired look while providing additional battery backup, making the earbuds suitable for music, videos, calls, and everyday portable use.
story: Designed around everyday convenience, these earbuds combine a compact in-ear format with straightforward touch controls for managing music and calls. The built-in microphone supports hands-free conversations, while Bluetooth connectivity allows use with compatible phones, tablets, and laptops. Their transparent charging case gives the set a distinctive visual identity and remains easy to carry. With wired case charging and additional backup from the case, the earbuds are suited to commutes, casual listening, and work-from-home routines.
highlights: Touch controls manage music and calls

specs.battery_backup: Up to 4–6 hours (earbuds), additional backup via case

shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
